headline: Defensive Real Estate and Consumer Staples Lead as Energy and Technology Deteriorate Across Global Equity Rotation
market_regime: Defensive & Value Leadership with Cyclical and Tech Deterioration
executive_summary: Quantitative rotation measurements indicate relative leadership shifting toward defensive sectors, real estate, and select international markets, while energy and technology experience significant relative momentum declines. Real estate benchmarks REZ (score 94.26) and US Consumer Staples XLP (score 92.27) reached 63-bar score highs, supported by positive 20-bar and 63-bar relative strength. Conversely, Oil Services OIH (score 10.74) and Nasdaq-100 QQQ (score 30.00) recorded 63-bar score lows. Direct pair signals highlight large-cap value IWD leading large-cap growth IWF with a +9.98 percentage point 20-bar spread. Multiple sectors exhibit mixed-horizon relative strength signals and pending raw trend changes that require ongoing confirmation.
